subject: The 2AM test that saved her 3 years
preview_text: One tiny trick that catches what your gut misses every time
body_paragraphs: She was about to delete the app. Then she tried one thing — a quick scan of her last 5 texts with him. It took 60 seconds. What it showed made her cancel dinner plans that night. Three months later, she found out he'd been love-bombing someone else the whole time.

Here's the tiny trick: screenshot your last conversation — the one you feel weird about but can't explain. Paste it into Red Flag Scanner AI. Look at the toxicity score. Then check the 'Pattern Frequency' tab. If it says 'Repeat' next to gaslighting or deflection, that's not a bad day. That's a pattern.

Most people ignore the quiet red flags because they don't have proof. This feature gives you proof in under a minute. No guessing. No second-guessing. Just a clear read on what's really happening. Users who do this once are 3x more likely to spot manipulation before it escalates.

Open the app right now. Scan one conversation you've been avoiding. See what comes up. P.S. — The 'Pattern Frequency' tab only lights up after 3+ scans. So do that one scan, then a second. You'll see the difference.
